structured.answer: I'd open an account at Psagot (the page marks it "הזול") and buy the "אי.בי.אי. מחקה (4A) ת"א 125" fund. I didn't change the page's example of 10,000 ₪ now plus 500 ₪ a month, and with that it says I'd end up with about 86,045 ₪ after 10 years. I never put in my own 30,000, so for me the final number would be different.

stuck.why: It already said 10,000 and 500, not my 30,000. The slider for 10,000 looked like it was at the end already, so I just left the page's numbers.

stuck.where: Screen 7–8, fund list, '−0.04%' and '−1,030 ₪' next to every fund
stuck.why: Every fund has a minus on it. I couldn't tell if that means losing money. The one marked 'הבחירה' had the smallest minus, so I went with it, but it scared me a bit.
At first I read the minus as losing 1,030 ₪, then I got that the second option just ends up with less.
Leumi, Hapoalim and Discount are names I trust, but they're 3,000–7,000 ₪ worse. Psagot I've heard of, so I was OK with it.
